x1gkz04d.author: Plato
x1gkz04d.label: The charioteer and the pair of winged horses
x1gkz04d.translation: And let the figure be composite--a pair of winged horses and a charioteer. Now the winged horses and the charioteers of the gods are all of them noble and of noble descent, but those of other races are mixed; the human charioteer drives his in a pair; and one of them is noble and of noble breed, and the other is ignoble and of ignoble breed; and the driving of them of necessity gives a great deal of trouble to him.
x1gkz04d.reading: The two horses are desire and θυμός, the charioteer is reason below and nous above. Her addition: nous is fiery by nature and must "cool" (ψύχεται) into soul, ψυχή, to take part in the game of matter. In the Ares talk the dark horse is the uncontrolled red force that must be purified, not killed.

tfdb67q.s: She says 'ancient' is mainly a matter of date.
tfdb67q.explain: It is a quality: one's position toward the principles.

id5jvoe.meaning: Identification with matter and habit keeps us stuck.

de2ng24.point: Only matter keeps its state; the more I identify with body and habit, the more inertia rules me.

s2tc6dx.title: The non-dual cascade of being
s2tc6dx.note: Nested like a babushka doll: a continuum, not a duality of mind and matter. She gives the same cascade, via Heraclitus, in the Chitheads talk (drptI20Rf5k, 36:52).

tf1pklknd.s: She says matter contains the soul.
tf1pklknd.explain: Following the Timaeus, the soul contains matter.

ddubt3l.point: The soul embraces the body; what is outside the body is the aura.

tf1kwruef.s: For the Presocratics, in her reading, matter was dead and mechanical.
tf1kwruef.explain: Matter was animate and interwoven with the divine.

tf1xppgyv.s: She says inertia applies to spirit as well as to matter.
tf1xppgyv.explain: Only matter has inertia, not spirit or νοῦς.

m1m8k127.title: Tea and scones for Mrs Medusa

beats.beat: She jokes about politely offering Medusa or the Hydra tea, scones and biscuits.
beats.reading: A monster or tyrant does not understand courtesy, only force, the power of life.

beats.beat: Instead one brings out Ares and Athena's 'dreadful' spirit.
beats.reading: Not shouting or hitting: it is the energy you carry, so even your peace 'has roots'.

w1g9gk2.q: Can we create a political structure that grounds the richness of spirit in human form?

e1go8snu.reading: Science is standing above and seeing the whole; whatever is not holistic is not scientific.

dp01wfw.point: Earth is closer to the sun in winter yet colder: what matters is how you incline toward spirit.

tf1mb7lss.s: She says the Pythagorean school united the Dionysian and Apollonian ways.
tf1mb7lss.explain: Heart and ecstasy joined with mind and science.

q1mf1bkb.q: What are the two Aphrodites she mentions?
q1mf1bkb.explain: Eros through spirit versus lustful, bodily eros.

etj1t1a.reading: To believe is to give credit that something may be so, and faith sits inside the word for science: no experiment begins without it.

d5say3h.point: Politics shifted from ideals, beliefs and religion to science as a means of power.

q1suhq7b.a: ἐπί + ἵσταμαι: standing above and seeing the whole
q1suhq7b.explain: Whatever is not holistic is not scientific in the ancient sense.

dy4jp6e.point: Joined in Pythagoreanism, with no matter-spirit dualism.

d1c1mwqb.point: Hellenism is a universal spirit, not a claim of superiority.

p1fto3uv.title: Write your intention
steps: Ask: why am I here, what do I truly want from this journey?
p1fto3uv.why: To see whether your motive has been transformed, fulfilled or has vanished.

plbwh5p.title: Attune at the solstices
steps: Treat solstices and equinoxes as days of heightened energy
plbwh5p.why: The ancient festival calendar was built around them.

p1u0v6pg.title: Stop the 'if... then' bargain
steps: Notice thoughts like 'after one more book, concept, trip or initiation, then...'
Recognise them as postponement into an imagined future
p1u0v6pg.why: The only right moment is now; even spiritual methods can become the last obstacle.

p1nld8qm.title: Say 'my dear One'
steps: At the tax office, on the road when cut off, in heated debates
p1nld8qm.why: Immanence means recognising the One in everything, including what annoys us.
